panels.description: Total number of workers and GPU accelerators in the cluster.
panels.title: Summary

panels.description: Average GPU core utilization across all accelerators in percent. Indicates how actively GPU compute resources are being used.
panels.title: Average GPU Utilization

panels.description: Average VRAM utilization in percent, calculated as the ratio of used memory to total capacity.
panels.title: Average VRAM Utilization

panels.description: Average GPU temperature in degrees Celsius. Helps monitor overheating and cooling efficiency.
panels.title: Average GPU Temperature

panels.description: Average GPU power utilization as a percentage of the power limit. Falls back to average power in watts if limit data is unavailable.
panels.title: Average GPU Power

panels.description: Total VRAM capacity across all GPUs in the cluster.
panels.title: VRAM Size

panels.description: Total system RAM capacity across all workers.
panels.title: Memory Size

panels.description: Total number of CPU cores across all workers.
panels.title: CPU Cores

panels.description: Detailed table of all GPUs: core utilization, VRAM usage, temperature, power consumption, and power limit for each accelerator.
panels.title: GPUs

panels.description: System RAM usage on each worker in bytes.
panels.title: System Memory Usage

panels.description: GPU compute core utilization in percent. A value of 100 indicates full utilization.
panels.title: GPU Utilization

panels.description: Percentage of VRAM used relative to available capacity for each GPU.
panels.title: VRAM Utilization

panels.description: CPU utilization percentage on each worker.
panels.title: CPU Utilization

panels.description: Total, used, and allocated VRAM for each GPU. Allocated memory is reserved by model instances.
panels.title: GPU Mem Usage

panels.description: GPU accelerator temperature in degrees Celsius. High temperatures may lead to throttling.
panels.title: GPU Temperature

panels.description: Current GPU power consumption in watts. Helps assess energy efficiency and power supply load.
panels.title: GPU Power Usage

panels.description: Bar chart of GPU core utilization. Average value per GPU over the period.
panels.title: GPU Utilization

panels.description: Bar chart of VRAM utilization. Average value per GPU over the period.
panels.title: VRAM Utilization
